review: Even at Uptie 4, R.B. Gregor does not offer much. His power scales with enemies being slower than him and enemies having Bleed but even with those online, he underperforms compared to other bleed identities. He has so many effects but those barely matter. Not worth Uptie 4, his passive is only better than Base Gregor’s if you are using R.B. Ryoshu. Collection purposes.
